verdicts.text: Section objective is embedded above nested curriculum content; no explicit assessment or competency mapping.
Analogue: explicit goal-to-project attach flow with downstream progress roll-up.
Marketing hero mentions planning, but no initiative or downstream relation is visible.

reject.reason: No initiative-to-project or other objective-to-work relationship is visible.
Standalone goal dashboard does not visibly identify connected supporting work.
Standalone goal detail says no sub-goals are connected and does not show a linked project.

takeCorrections.take: Udemy attaches a learning objective to a curriculum section containing nested lecture/content controls; it does not prove objective mapping to an individual lesson, assessment, or competency.
Asana's sampled previews show a goal-to-project connection from empty state, through project search, to a connected row with progress roll-up; this is a cross-domain analogue.

counterCandidates.reason: Broad planning language without an observable relationship control or linked entity.
